scope: Actual public RegionMarks Processing 4.5.6 JAVA2D PDE lifecycle, edit callbacks, retained partition geometry, ordinary authored-cell transfer, and cached-canvas save. This validates the editable Java example only; pure partition conformance and upstream whole-sketch reproduction remain separate.
save: Post actual s key after authored-grid. Require exactly one PDE save equal to the displayed authored-grid canvas, with no extra composition during a measured at-least-300ms quiet observation.
checks: all eleven exact option states and eleven posted key events including S
M/M/C style edits preserve exact RegionComposition identity and every retained bound/id; M reset replays base pixels
N/G/R/X rebuild composition; count reset and fraction reset restore exact base geometry under their then-current style
N changes final live-list output rather than claiming a final-output prefix; G and R change seeded geometry
X is eleven authored ordinary cells after two explicit 2x3 actions and the same grid-mark content path consumes every cell
all registered output sizes, JAVA2D/density environment, opaque/nonblank captures and cached S save
failure_policy: Preflight/build before launch. A render reserves one attempt under the shared Processing lock; any terminal failure consumes it and preserves stdout, stderr, progress, attempt state and result. No automatic retry, stale-output reuse, or unrelated native suite rerun.
